create_tableformer_prediction_provider: create a TableFormerPredictionProvider instance with configurable mode, threads, and artifacts path for table structure prediction
run_predict_table_structure: run table structure prediction on a DatasetRecord containing a PDF or PNG document using TableFormer
build_tableformer_updater: build a TableFormerUpdater with mode and thread settings to replace table data in a DoclingDocument
replace_tabledata_pdf: replace table data in a PDF document with TableFormer predictions given a PDF stream and ground truth document
replace_tabledata_with_page_tokens: replace table data in a single-page document using page tokens and page images with TableFormer
